facts.fact: The Instituto de Modernizacao Administrativa's terms of reference (document 01/IMA/2026, version 1.2 of 9 March 2026, under the PADA project) procure a five-month consultancy to structure, draft and consolidate the Politica Nacional de Gestao e Hospedagem de Dados Publicos and its implementing regulation, including hosting rules by data category (on-premises, government or sovereign cloud, hybrid, conditions for public cloud) and residency rules.
